body.name: Hypergraph certificate handle
body.construction: Handle: form \(\mathfrak H_R\) from one vertex class for complete states, one for observed projections \(\operatorname{pr}_m(s)\), and one for strict-dominance edges; label its signed incidence rows by the equality and sensitivity rows of \(E\) and \(G_{\Gamma}\), then study balancedness and network-matrix representations of this incidence system.
